label: A power exercised in a giving withheld under the same set-up is rational (strong version)
paraphrase: OPEN (DNP-prime, analyst formulation; STRONG version): for every being y at w, if y gives x being at w by its power p and, at an accessible world where y exists with the same set-up, does not give x being, then p is rational. Met. Theta 5's rule that a non-rational potency, agent and patient meeting, must act, applied to every being (navigation). With excluded middle it is exactly the denial of CHANCE_3 (an indeterministic non-rational propensity) at w (controls, law 11). Its universal scope is challenged by indeterministic physical propensities on stochastic readings of quantum mechanics (note, section 5); the weak version below suffices for the will route.
